correctness.rationale: Equation (1) enumerates the exact disjoint cases of a uniform seed being in an open component of size one or two. Prüfer enumeration covers exactly all labeled trees orders 2–7, canonical center encodings yield 24 unlabeled shapes, and the exact transformation (2) certifies a universally minimal vaccinated vertex for 23 of them for every p in (0,1). Explicit factored polynomial differences prove the remaining seven-vertex shape has no universal optimum, switching sharply at 3/5. The exact script ran with output VERIFY_OK and independently reconstructed 35 witness rational cases. Enumeration is bounded to seven vertices and no larger-tree claim is made.

The only close own findings optimize epidemic mean, epidemic-tree shape, or infection detection instead of vaccinated-vertex three-case risk. Relevant published published-finding corpus searches found no equivalent, but nonhits alone do not establish uniqueness. value.rationale: A threshold exceedance probability is a natural risk-sensitive epidemic containment objective distinct from average outbreak size. The exact sharp finite minimum order and exceptional topology show when intervention priorities provably depend on transmissibility. Structural change from connector removal to hub removal is meaningful and algorithmically reproducible; the model assumes idealized perfect vaccines, independent contacts, uniform post-vaccination seed and only a 3-case threshold.
